title: Bug 649448: [Subcontracting] [IT] Fully received WIP purchase orders block Disable Legacy Subcontracting
summary: Fully received work-in-progress purchase order lines no longer prevent disabling the Legacy Subcontracting feature.
key_points: Fixed a prerequisite check that incorrectly counted fully received WIP purchase orders as open
Allows users to disable Legacy Subcontracting when WIP purchase orders are fully received
Added regression test to verify the fix and prevent recurrence
Verified the fix works correctly and does not break existing validation
quote: Fix the Legacy Subcontracting disable prerequisite so fully received WIP purchase order lines no longer count as open.
